paragraphs: Scheidt & Bachmann USA markets Parking Solutions and Fare Collection Systems in the US. The US Headquarters in Lowell, MA houses project management, field service, software support and spare parts repair for the Parking and Fare Collection lines. That facility also holds an ISO 9001-2015 certified manufacturing floor producing Fare Collection hardware.

Fare Collection Systems supplies ticketing systems for transport operators. Parking Solutions covers system solutions for parking management of any size. Energy Retail Solutions addresses the transformation of petrol stations into mobility hubs.

Local service and sales offices are listed in Baltimore, MD; Miami, FL; Houston, TX; Phoenix, AZ; and Hayward, CA. The values page states that the owner families have held the goal of keeping Scheidt & Bachmann a family business since its foundation in 1872.

quote.text: Scheidt & Bachmann Fare Collection Systems is a leading provider of ticketing systems for transport operators.
